Ray‐Box Intersection Using the Slab Method | Every Algorithm
Nov 9, 2024The slab method is a classic way to test whether a ray intersects an axis‑aligned bounding box (AABB). It reduces the 3‑D intersection test to a series of simple one‑dimensional comparisons along each axis. Below is a step‑by‑step outline of the algorithm.
